Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A general knowledge quiz show approached a taxi driver and a physician about being contestants. Both had to take a test beforehand to see if they should be on the show. The taxi driver got nearly every answer wrong and was excluded because they wouldn't be a good contestant, but the physician scored well and was selected. Who is intelligent?
A. The taxi driver
B. Cannot answer
C. The physician
